tickets.subject: Can't log in
tickets.body: I can't log in to my account this morning. I tried my usual password and it's not working. I haven't changed it. Help!

tickets.subject: Charge looks wrong
tickets.body: My March invoice has a $1,247 charge for AI Platform that doesn't match what I've used. I checked the usage page and it shows about $300 of activity. Can someone look into this?

tickets.subject: Is something down?
tickets.body: Our API calls to Cloud Storage have been timing out for the last 20 minutes. We're in us-east1. Status page doesn't show anything. Is this a known issue?

tickets.subject: RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED on Vertex
tickets.body: Started getting RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED errors on text-embedding requests around 9am Pacific. We're well under our previous usage. Did something change?

tickets.subject: Need a refund — this is urgent
tickets.body: We were billed $3,400 for a service we cancelled in February. I have the cancellation confirmation. I need a human to look at this immediately or I'm going to escalate to my legal team.

tickets.subject: Multi-issue: cancellation, refund, and a current outage
tickets.body: Three things. (1) We cancelled our contract on Feb 10 but were still charged $4,200 in March — we want a refund of the full amount. (2) Our remaining production workloads are seeing intermittent timeouts to Cloud Storage in us-central1 — about 1 in 20 requests fails. (3) When this is sorted, please send us instructions on exporting our remaining data so we can move off the platform. Time-sensitive — we have a board update in 48 hours.
